name: Bề bề
summary: Bề bề is on the 28 July 2025 special-zone eat list and on the 20 June 2013 board by the kilogram. The board also splits “to” and “nhỏ”. The 8 January 2016 article says the island’s seafood is best in winter, before the spring spawn.
